title: Adversarial Red-Teaming Subprocess Isolation

claims.assertion: PyRIT adversarial prompt converters and scoring endpoints require subprocess containerization with explicit execution deadlines.
External security tooling must not run in-process to prevent uncaught adversarial side-effects or event bus pollution.

distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
Security and red-teaming converter plugins (e.g. PyRIT) must execute within isolated subprocess containers with strict timeout barriers to prevent adversarial execution hangs.
